olivia (sec-eng): hitting intermittent SAML decrypt errors for a few EU tenants -> login 500 'decrypt failed'.

sam (infra-kms): any KMS activity/rotation? I rotated idp-wrap @05:12 UTC.

olivia (sec-eng): logs: 'jwe: unsupported header alg "A256GCM"' but KMS audit shows decrypt OK for same req id.

anita (identity): paste snippet? Did SP metadata or attr-encryption change?

olivia (sec-eng):
```
level=error svc=sp-decrypt tenant=tenant-az1 err="jwe: unsupported header alg 'A256GCM'" req=abc123
level=info svc=kms tenant=tenant-az1 action=Decrypt key=idp-wrap key_version=7 status=ok req=abc123
```

sam (infra-kms): we bumped jose lib last week; it enforces stricter headers. Could break older connectors.

ryan (sre): also rolled new minimal-role for service accounts yesterday; I'll verify KMS perms for SP SA.

anita (identity): customer claims IdP unchanged; older ES-2 connectors failing, newer OK — connector translation likely. I'll request a redacted assertion.

olivia (sec-eng): mitigation: enable tenant-gated permissive header fallback in sp-decrypt + add debug header logging. Sam to patch.

sam (infra-kms): will open small patch and PR.

dryan (sre): deploy canary to eu-west-1 and monitor KMS audit/errors. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued -> 3 pods eu-west-1. Health checks +5m/+15m.

olivia (sec-eng): also add parse_failure metric + alert (>10/min). Anita to file.

sam (infra-kms): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sp-decrypt/pull/824 (header fallback + logging).

ryan (sre): RBAC check done; SA perms intact.

olivia (sec-eng): canary reduces errors for tenant-az1. Next: harden parser, release proper fix, postmortem with connector owners. Owners: sam patch, anita comms, ryan monitoring, olivia writeup.
